Deloitte is a multinational professional services network and one of the "Big Four" accounting firms globally, alongside Ernst & Young (EY), KPMG, and PwC. Founded in London in 1845 by William Welch Deloitte, the network operates through a web of independent member firms across more than 150 countries and territories.

Core Services

• Audit & Assurance: Traditional financial statement audits, internal controls assurance, and regulatory compliance.
• Consulting: Strategy, analytics, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), human capital, and digital transformation.
• Tax & Legal: Global tax advice, transfer pricing, and legal services.
• Risk & Financial Advisory: Cybersecurity, risk management, and restructuring assistance.

Accenture is a global professional services and technology company that provides strategy, consulting, digital, technology, and operations services. [1] 
## Key Overview & Metrics

* Headquarters: Dublin, Ireland
* Leadership: Chair and CEO Julie Sweet
* Global Workforce: Approximately 814,000 employees
* Client Reach: Serves more than 9,000 clients across 120+ countries
* Fiscal Revenue: Approximately $74 billion
* History: Formerly known as Andersen Consulting before rebranding to Accenture in 2001. [2, 3, 4] 

## Core Services & Capabilities

* Strategy & Consulting: Business reinvention, operating models, change management, and industry-specific advising. [1, 4] 
* Technology & Cloud: Systems integration, software engineering, cloud computing, cybersecurity, and data/AI solutions. [1, 3] 
* Operations: Business process outsourcing across supply chain, finance, procurement, and marketing. [1] 
* Ecosystem Partners: Deep alliances with major tech leaders including Microsoft, AWS, Google, Oracle, SAP, and Salesforce. [5, 6] 

You can learn more on the official [Accenture Company Overview](https://www.accenture.com/en/about/company-index) or review their latest figures via the [Accenture Fact Sheet](https://newsroom.accenture.com/fact-sheet). [2, 4]
